evidence_definitions.measured: Benchmark run and evidence on named scene, pinned ref, known device and fixed conditions

evidence_definitions.blocked_preflight: Test did not reach the behavioral/visual benchmark
evidence_definitions.mixed_failure: Separate dependency, configuration and/or environmental failures in same workflow
